channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Supply chain attack on arrayref
item.description: What happened On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the proc-macro1 crate was malicious. The Rust Security Response Team verified this to be the case: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload. (3 sources: lobsters, rprogramming, rustblog)

item.title: S3 Compatibility Doesn't Guarantee S3-Level Security
item.description: Security researchers at Wiz recently examined S3-compatible object storage services across six popular neoclouds, revealing significant security gaps compared to Amazon S3. (1 source: infoq)
